texto: «Als» equals «when» in Spanish, but only for the non-recurrent past: **Als ich in Wien war, besuchte ich ein Museum** (when I was in Vienna, I visited a museum).
If the fact was usually repeated, «als» cannot be used, but «wenn» (**immer wenn**).

bloques.titulo: Structure of the sentence with al
texto: As a subordinate conjunction, «als» sends the conjugated verb at the end of its clause: **Als ich klein war**. If the subordinate goes at first, the main sentence starts with the verb (investment): **Als ich klein war, wohnte ich in Berlin**.

frases.de: Wann warst du zum ersten Mal in Wien?
frases.es: ¿Cuándo estuviste por primera vez en Viena?
frases.en: When were you first in Vienna?

frases.de: Als ich zwanzig Jahre alt war, besuchte ich die Stadt.
frases.es: Cuando tenía veinte años, visité la ciudad.
frases.en: When I was 20, I visited the city.
analisis: als ich zwanzig Jahre alt war

frases.de: Und was hast du dort gesehen?
frases.en: And what did you see there?

frases.de: Als ich am Bahnhof ankam, sah ich ein berühmtes Museum.
frases.es: Cuando llegué a la estación, vi un museo famoso.
frases.en: When I got to the station, I saw a famous museum.
analisis: When I got to the station

bloques.pregunta: When is the «als» conjunction used in German?

opciones.texto: For a unique event or period in the past
opciones.explicacion: «Als» is reserved for time facts or past singular stages.

opciones.texto: For repeated actions in the past or present
opciones.explicacion: For repeated actions («provided that») «wenn» is used.

bloques.pregunta: What position does the conjugated verb occupy within a clause introduced by «als»?

opciones.texto: At the absolute end of the subordinate
opciones.explicacion: As a subordinate conjunction, «als» moves the conjugated verb at the end of the clause.
That would be the order of a coordinated, non-subordinate prayer.

opciones.texto: At the beginning of the sentence before «als»
opciones.explicacion: The verb never precedes the conjunction in the subordinate.

bloques.pregunta: When it was unique in the past
bloques.frase: ___ ich gestern nach Hause kam, schlief mein Bruder schon.

opciones.explicacion: «Als» is the right conjunction for a time of time and unique in the past.
«Wenn» would be used for repeated or present situations.

bloques.frase: Als wir in Berlin waren, ___ wir das Museum.

opciones.explicacion: Second-position verb of the main after the initial temporary subordinate.
«besuchen» is infinitive or present of indicative.
«besucht» is a participle or present form for «ihr».

bloques.frase: Als ich in Wien war, besuchte ich ein berühmtes Museum.

opciones.texto: When I was in Vienna, I visited a famous museum.
opciones.explicacion: als = when (unique past); besuchte ich = visited; berühmtes = famous.

opciones.texto: Whenever he went to Vienna, he visited the same museum.
Although I was in Vienna, I didn't visit any museum.
opciones.explicacion: Prayer is affirmative and not concessional.

bloques.frase: Als das Konzert zu Ende war, ___ meine Freunde nach Hause.

opciones.explicacion: Präteritum in second position of the main sentence (fuhren alle Gäste).
«fuhr» is singular and here the subject is plural («alle Gäste»).

bloques.frase: Als der Zug ankam wartete Julia
bloques.traduccion: When the train arrived Julia was waiting
bloques.explicacion: als introduces the subordinate with verb at the end.

intro: The temporary conjunction «als» is used exclusively in the past to introduce a unique, timely event or an unrepeatable period of life (e.g. in childhood or during a specific journey).
